Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Foundry Summit — Silver+ sponsorship package and stage slot

Hi Stephanie,

Great to meet you at Connections last week — thanks for the quick call. Attached is our updated Silver+ package (v2) with stage slot language, logo placements, and the standard SOW. Highlights:

- One 15-minute breakout on the Emerging Infra track (morning session)
- Logo on main stage backdrop (medium size) and mobile app sponsor carousel
- Two comp exhibitor passes + 5 attendee passes at 20% off
- Lead retrieval via QR scans (CSV export provided)

We can hold pricing of $45,000 through Dec 8 if you want to secure the slot. Please review and let me know any must-haves; we can iterate.

Attachment: Foundry_Spons_SilverPlus_v2.pdf (pdf, 1.8MB)

Best,
Emily Stone

Foundry Summit
emily.stone@foundrysummit.com

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Foundry Summit — Silver+ sponsorship package and stage slot

Thanks, Emily — this looks like a solid starting point. A few clarifying items from our side before we move to redlines:

1) Speaking slot: can you confirm whether the 15-minute breakout is a solo slot or part of a panel? We prefer a solo 20-minute demo + 10-minute Q&A (total 30) if possible.
2) Logo placement: can we get a screenshot of the stage backdrop mock showing the medium size placement vs other sponsors? We want main stage visibility on the keynote day, not only in the track.
3) Lead capture: is the QR scan CSV delivered within 24 hours after session or only post-event?
4) Social: can we secure at least two dedicated social posts (X/LinkedIn) calling out our session?

Budget note: $45k is in range but we'd like to confirm additional promotional deliverables before committing.

Looping in Laura (Field Marketing) and Ben (Partnerships) to weigh in on inventory and negotiation margins. Laura — can you weigh in on whether we should push for a 30-minute slot vs two 15-minute slots? Ben — will own the contract negotiation if we proceed.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@foundrysummit.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Foundry Summit — Silver+ sponsorship package and stage slot

Hi Stephanie — great questions. Couple of clarifications:

- Speaking: We can convert the 15-minute breakout into a 30-minute solo session (20-min talk + 10-min Q&A) but that moves you into Silver+ premium inventory; we can accommodate it at the Silver+ price if confirmed by Dec 8.
- Stage mock: attaching a stage mock screenshot and the revised package v3. The medium logo on the main stage will appear to the left of center on the backdrop; your logo will also rotate in the event app carousel during keynote days.
- Lead CSV: delivered within 24 hours after the session; we'll include registration/opt-in flags.
- Social: we can commit to 2 dedicated social posts + 1 story on the conference day.

I've attached the updated PDF and the SOW for review. If you approve the amended benefits, we'll send a DocuSign envelope.

Attachments: Foundry_Spons_SilverPlus_v3.pdf (pdf, 2.1MB); SOW_Foundry_SilverPlus.pdf (pdf, 250KB)

Let me know if you'd like me to hold the slot.

Best,
Emily

Subject: Internal: Foundry Summit — recommend next steps

Laura/Ben — quick internal note after their response (see v3). My read:

- 30-minute solo slot is valuable for product demo + customer Q&A; pushes session to higher visibility.
- Stage placement seems acceptable but ask for a stage mock with scale reference (logo sizes of other sponsors).
- Social deliverables (2 posts + story) are required.

Decision points:
1) Pricing — they hold at $45k but we should try to land closer to $40–43k given our Q4 budget and expected pipeline.
2) Add a featured session mention in the event guide and one more social amplification (total 3 posts) as non-monetary value.

Ben — can you take lead on negotiating cost and contract redlines? If we can get $43k + 3 posts + stage mock, I say sign. Need final by Dec 5 so we can route purchase order.

Steph

I'm attaching a short redline doc with the SOW tweaks. If you can accept the $43k and the above promotional items, we'll sign the DocuSign envelope today and route a PO.
